title: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
abstract: arXiv:2605.20242v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efficient discovery of precursor additives is essential for improving the performance of perovskite solar cells, yet the large chemical space makes conventional trial-and-error screening inefficient. Here we show that LEAP (LLM-driven Exploration via Active Learning for Perovskites), a closed-loop framework combining a domain-specialized language model with active learning, prioritizes perovskite precursor additives under low-data conditions. The model extracts mechanism-relevant knowledge from the literature and converts it into interpretable molecular descriptors for uncertainty-aware Bayesian optimization. On an evaluation drawn from unseen literature, the specialized model provides more mechanism-consistent answers than the tested general-purpose models. translated_title: 一种用于钙钛矿前驱体添加剂发现的闭环框架
translated_abstract: 高效发现前驱体添加剂对于提升钙钛矿太阳能电池的性能至关重要，然而庞大的化学空间使得传统的试错式筛选效率低下。本研究提出了LEAP（基于大语言模型与主动学习的钙钛矿探索框架），这是一个将领域专业化语言模型与主动学习相结合的闭环框架，能够在低数据条件下对钙钛矿前驱体添加剂进行优先排序。该模型从文献中提取与作用机理相关的知识，并将其转化为可解释的分子描述符，用于具备不确定性感知能力的贝叶斯优化。在一项基于未见过的文献进行的评估中，该专业化模型比所测试的通用模型给出了更符合机理的答案。在一项专家指导的概念验证研究中，两个后期轮次筛选出的添加剂将器件的平均功率转换效率分别提升至20.13%和20.87%（相比对照的19.25%）
tldr: 该论文提出LEAP闭环框架，将领域专业化大语言模型与主动学习相结合，从文献中提取机理知识并转化为可解释分子描述符进行贝叶斯优化，从而在低数据条件下高效发现钙钛矿前驱体添加剂，将太阳能电池效率提升至20.87%。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LEAP, a closed-loop framework combining a domain-specialized LLM with active learning that extracts mechanistic knowledge from literature into interpretable molecular descriptors for Bayesian optimization, enabling efficient discovery of perovskite precursor additives under low-data conditions and boosting solar cell efficiency to 20.87%.
